snippet.title: Making A Controversial Game
snippet.description:
#2d #indiedevelopers  #gamedev  #pixelart #devlog #plzwatch #indiegame #new #playdate  #itchio
@itchiogames 
@PanicVideo 
In this video I discuss how I made a game for a game console, and a sequel to my most popular game.

Remember, that buying Santa On The Run is the best way to support the channel!
My Itch Page: https://descongamesyt.itch.io/

The Game: https://descongamesyt.itch.io/better-cluck-next-time-ii

And, you don't need a link to subscribe. You know where it is ;)
